status: Frozen generation and evaluation design before fresh datasets or model fits
historical_data_role: Development evidence only; no historical test split is confirmatory
target: D_P(rho)=Tr(rho^2)-Tr(rho P rho P), P=(n dot sigma) tensor I
axis_rule: Training and validation use |n_x| <= 0.55; axis-only and joint tests use |n_x| > 0.55
selection: Choose model and hyperparameters on development training and validation only; do not use confirmation test labels for selection
paired_evaluation: All methods share states, contexts and labels within each dataset; report each dataset and optimizer start
uncertainty: Aggregate squared errors by state; use state clusters conditional on sampled contexts, or crossed state/context resampling for both populations
copy_scope: Exact-expectation training; copy-matched inference is a separate study
